coder_notes: Eligibility is 'WHO grade 4 glioma' without IDH requirement, with Glioblastoma named in conditions; treated as historical glioblastoma terminology (D27C). Circulating and infiltrating MDSC counts are cellular pharmacodynamic endpoints, not molecular biomarkers, so no biomarker row. Bevacizumab is given to all patients at a fixed dose and is coded as standard-of-care backbone.
